itemdesc-philosophersstone:
Right-click a block to transmute it into its neighbour in a chain (stone types, wood types, sand ↔ gravel, ...); sneak + right-click goes the other way.
Tool-mode key: 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 at once. Free, and never used up when crafting with it.
itemdesc-transmutationtablet: A transmutation table you carry: right-click to open it anywhere. Burn items into EMC to learn them, then create anything you know from your EMC.
itemdesc-alchemicalfuel-alchemicalcoal: Burns at 1,400 °C for 160 seconds. In a forge it lasts 4x as long and burns 200 °C hotter.
itemdesc-alchemicalfuel-mobiusfuel: Burns at 1,500 °C for 640 seconds. In a forge it lasts 16x as long and burns 400 °C hotter. Made from 4 alchemical coal.
itemdesc-alchemicalfuel-aeternalisfuel: Burns at 1,600 °C for 2,560 seconds. In a forge it lasts 64x as long and burns 600 °C hotter. Made from 4 mobius fuel; the base of dark matter.
itemdesc-matter-dark: Condensed EMC: 8 aeternalis fuel around a temporal gear. Tier 5 tools and armour made from it never wear out. 4 make a dark matter block.
itemdesc-matter-red: Denser still: 3 dark matter between 6 aeternalis fuel. Tier 6 tools and armour that never wear out. 4 make a red matter block.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-pickaxe: Digs stone, ore and metal at speed 9. Tool-mode key: 3x3 at once (sneak for one block). 3.5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-shovel: Digs soil, sand, gravel and snow at speed 9. Tool-mode key: 3x3 at once (sneak for one block). 3.5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-axe: Chops wood at speed 9 and fells whole trees. Tool-mode key: 3x3 at once (sneak for one block). 5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-sword: 8 attack (a steel falx does 5.25), reach 2.75 blocks. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-hoe: Tills soil into farmland; digs soil and plants at speed 5. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-hammer: Sledgehammer: smashes stone, ore and other hard blocks at speed 8, 3x3 at a time; sneak or the tool-mode key for one block. 5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-pickaxe: Digs stone, ore and metal at speed 14. Tool-mode key: 3x3 or 5x5 at once (sneak for one block). 4.5 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-shovel: Digs soil, sand, gravel and snow at speed 14. Tool-mode key: 3x3 or 5x5 at once (sneak for one block). 4.5 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-axe: Chops wood at speed 14 and fells whole trees. Tool-mode key: 3x3 or 5x5 at once (sneak for one block). 7 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-sword: 11 attack (a steel falx does 5.25), reach 2.75 blocks. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-hoe: Tills soil into farmland; digs soil and plants at speed 8. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-hammer: Sledgehammer: smashes stone, ore and other hard blocks at speed 12, 3x3 at a time (5x5 with the tool-mode key); sneak or the tool-mode key for one block. 7 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
blockdesc-transmutationtable: Right-click to open. Burn items into EMC to learn them, then create anything you know from your EMC. The window closes if you walk more than 10 blocks away.
blockdesc-energycollector-mk1:
Makes up to 4 EMC a second in full sunlight (less in shade, none in the dark) and stores 10,000.
Feeds condensers, furnaces and relays next to it every second; sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-energycollector-mk2:
Makes up to 12 EMC a second in full sunlight (less in shade, none in the dark) and stores 30,000.
Feeds condensers, furnaces and relays next to it every second; sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-energycollector-mk3:
Makes up to 40 EMC a second in full sunlight (less in shade, none in the dark) and stores 60,000.
Feeds condensers, furnaces and relays next to it every second; sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-energycondenser-mk1:
Put an item in the target slot: it burns up to 4 other items a second (plus EMC from collectors) and makes up to 1 copy of the target a second.
Stores up to 1,000,000 EMC; 40 storage slots.
blockdesc-energycondenser-mk2:
Put an item in the target slot: it burns up to 16 other items a second (plus EMC from collectors) and makes up to 4 copies of the target a second.
Stores up to 10,000,000 EMC; 40 storage slots.
gui-burn-hint: Drop an item on the burn slot to turn it into EMC and learn it. Left-click burns the whole stack, right-click burns one.
gui-create-hint: Left-click: take one  ·  Right-click: take a stack  ·  Shift-click: stack straight into your inventory  ·  Ctrl + right-click: forget
condenser-notarget: EMC {0}. Put an item in the target slot.
error-noaccess: You need to be at a transmutation table or carry a transmutation tablet.
error-hascontents: Empty {0} first - it still has things inside.
error-cursorbusy: Put down what you're holding first.
error-notransmutable: The philosopher's stone can't transmute this block.
cmd-holdsomething: Hold an item in your active hotbar slot.
cmd-recalc: Mapped {0} EMC values in {1} ms from {2} conversions.
cmd-missing: {0} of {1} blocks/items have no EMC value. Biggest groups: {2}. Full list: {3}
cmd-missing-none: All {0} blocks/items in the creative inventory have an EMC value.
chat-announce: Vintage-E version {0}: calculated {1} EMC values, {2} missing.
chat-announce-cached: Vintage-E version {0}: {1} EMC values (calculated earlier, nothing has changed), {2} missing.
missing-summary: {0} of {1} blocks/items in the creative inventory have no EMC value ({2} values calculated, Vintage-E {3}). Give them values in ModConfig/vintagee.json (BaseValues) or a config/vintagee-emc.json asset, then /emc recalc.
missing-summary-none: All {0} blocks/items in the creative inventory have an EMC value (Vintage-E {1}).
missing-copied: Copied {0} codes to the clipboard, ready to paste into BaseValues.
missing-empty: Nothing is missing - every block and item has an EMC value.
error-noprivilege: Only admins (controlserver privilege) can change EMC values.
missing-select: Click a name to give it a value (admins).
missing-badvalue: Type a number (0 or more) first.
cmdhelp-notadmin: Commands marked (admin) need the controlserver privilege.
cmdhelp-emc: Your EMC, and the EMC value of the item you're holding.
cmdhelp-missing: Opens a searchable list of blocks/items with no EMC value, where you can give them one. Also writes ModData/vintagee/emc-missing.csv.
cmdhelp-set: Gives the held item a fixed EMC value (0 removes its value). Saved to ModConfig/vintagee.json; values are recalculated.
cmdhelp-clear: Removes the fixed value you set for the held item.
cmdhelp-recalc: Recalculates every EMC value from the loaded recipes.
cmdhelp-dump: Writes every value, and what it was worked out from, to ModData/vintagee/emc-values.csv.
cmdhelp-give: Adds EMC to your personal EMC.
cmdhelp-learn: Learns the held item for transmutation without burning it.
itemdesc-covalencedust-low: Used to build alchemical gear. 40 from 8 stones + 1 charcoal.
itemdesc-covalencedust-medium: Used to build alchemical gear. 40 from 1 iron ingot + 1 saltpeter.
itemdesc-covalencedust-high: Used to build alchemical gear. 40 from 1 diamond + 1 coke.
itemdesc-kleinstar-ein:
Holds up to 50,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
itemdesc-ironband: The base of every ring. 8 iron ingots around 1 alchemical coal.
itemdesc-trinket-blackholeband:
While on: pulls loose items within 7 blocks to you. Free.
Right-click a water or lava source to remove it.
On a pedestal: pulls in items within 10 blocks and puts them into containers next to the pedestal.
Works from your hotbar or backpack; right-click to switch on/off.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
itemdesc-trinket-swiftwolfsrendinggale:
While on: you can fly (jump to rise, sneak to sink) and/or a shield pushes hostile creatures and arrows away within 5 blocks; pick flight + shield, flight or shield with the tool-mode key.
The tool-mode key also picks your speed, running and flying: 1x, 1.5x, 2x or 3x.
Flying costs 6.4 EMC a second x your speed while you are in the air; running faster than normal costs 6.4 EMC a second x (speed - 1) while you move; the shield costs 6.4 EMC a second. No fall damage while it's on and for 15 seconds after you stop flying. It switches off when you run out of EMC.
On a pedestal: strikes hostile creatures within 10 blocks for 4 damage a second.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
itemdesc-trinket-harvestgoddessband:
While on: crops within 5 blocks grow (6 tries a second, 4 EMC per stage) and ripe ones are harvested. Switched off it still grows nearby crops slowly, for free.
Right-click farmland to plant the seeds you carry on empty farmland up to 8 blocks around.
On a pedestal: grows and harvests crops within 8 blocks.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
itemdesc-trinket-ignitionring:
Carry it (on or off) and fire can't hurt you.
While on: hostile creatures within 5 blocks catch fire and take 3 damage, 4 EMC each, once a second.
Fire-projectile key (R): shoots a fireball (3 damage and sets the creature alight). Free.
On a pedestal: burns hostile creatures within 8 blocks.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
itemdesc-trinket-zeroring:
While on: still water within 3 blocks of you freezes into ice. Free.
On a pedestal: freezes water within 6 blocks and puts out burning creatures.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
itemdesc-trinket-ringofarcana:
The Zero Ring, Ignition Ring, Harvest Goddess Band and Swiftwolf's Rending Gale in one, and all free.
The tool-mode key switches each of the four on or off (all on to start). Fire can't hurt you while you carry it.
Fire-projectile key (R): shoots a fireball while its Ignition effect is on.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
itemdesc-trinket-bodystone:
While on: when you are 100 saturation or more below full, it feeds you up to 200 saturation for 0.5 EMC each (every 2 seconds).
On a pedestal: feeds players within 6 blocks 25 saturation a second, free.
itemdesc-trinket-soulstone:
While on: heals you 1 health a second for 64 EMC each.
On a pedestal: heals players within 6 blocks 0.5 health a second, free.
itemdesc-trinket-lifestone:
Body Stone and Soul Stone in one: feeds you (0.5 EMC per saturation) and heals you (64 EMC per health) while on.
On a pedestal: feeds and heals players within 6 blocks, free.
itemdesc-trinket-repairtalisman:
Always works while you carry it: repairs 1 durability a second on every damaged tool, weapon and piece of armour you carry or wear, and restores clothing condition (1% a minute by default; the server can change or turn that off). Free.
On a pedestal: does the same for players within 6 blocks.
itemdesc-trinket-gemofeternaldensity:
While on: every 2 seconds it eats cheap junk you carry (anything worth 8 EMC or less: stone, soil, sand, gravel, sticks...) and turns it into the target.
Targets (tool-mode key): iron ingot, gold ingot, diamond, dark matter, red matter. Leftover EMC is kept for next time.
itemdesc-trinket-evertideamulet:
Right-click a block to place a water source next to it. Free.
Fire-projectile key (R): shoots a ball of water that leaves a water source where it lands.
On a pedestal: makes it rain until you take it off.
itemdesc-trinket-volcaniteamulet:
Right-click a block to place a lava source next to it, 32 EMC each.
Fire-projectile key (R): shoots a ball of lava (32 EMC) that leaves a lava source where it lands.
Carry it and fire can't hurt you. On a pedestal: clears the sky until you take it off.
itemdesc-trinket-watchofflowingtime:
While on: time runs 10x faster for the whole world (crops, cooking, curing, drying, day and night) for 8 EMC a second, and crops within 6 blocks get extra growth.
Tool-mode key: slow time to a third instead (4 EMC a second), which also slows hostile creatures within 10 blocks.
On a pedestal: grows crops within 12 blocks and slows hostile creatures, free.
itemdesc-gadget-destructioncatalyst: Right-click a block to break a 3x3 tunnel into it: 1, 4, 8 or 16 blocks deep (charge 0-3, tool-mode key). 8 EMC per block broken; everything drops where you clicked.
itemdesc-gadget-hyperkineticlens:
Right-click (or the fire-projectile key, R) to shoot an explosive charge. It flies straight at 36 blocks a second and explodes where it hits.
Charge (tool-mode key): radius 4, 6, 8 or 10 for 384, 768, 1,536 or 2,304 EMC.
itemdesc-gadget-catalyticlens:
Right-click a block to break a 3x3 tunnel 1, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 or 64 blocks deep (charge 0-7, tool-mode key), 8 EMC per block.
Fire-projectile key (R): shoots the Hyperkinetic Lens's explosive charge (charge 3 and up: radius 10, 2,304 EMC).
itemdesc-gadget-mercurialeye:
Sneak + right-click a block to remember it, then right-click blocks to turn them into it (1x1, or 3x3 of the same block with the tool-mode key).
You pay the difference in EMC, and get it back when the old block was worth more.
itemdesc-gadget-archangelssmite:
Right-click: fires a homing arrow that steers towards hostile creatures (3 damage). Left-click: a volley of 10.
Each arrow costs what an arrow is worth in EMC.
itemdesc-gadget-tomeofknowledge: Right-click to learn every item that has an EMC value. Not used up.
itemdesc-gadget-diviningrodlow: Right-click a block: reports the total and average EMC of the 3x3 column below it, 3 blocks deep, and the most valuable block found.
itemdesc-gadget-diviningrodmedium: Right-click a block: reports the total and average EMC of the 3x3 column below it, 16 blocks deep, and the most valuable block found.
itemdesc-gadget-diviningrodhigh: Right-click a block: reports the total and average EMC of the 3x3 column below it, 64 blocks deep, and the most valuable block found.
itemdesc-redmattertool-katar: Sword, axe and shears in one: 14 attack (a steel falx does 5.25), reach 3 blocks; chops wood at speed 16 and fells whole trees; cuts plants and leaves at 14, 3x3 or 5x5 with the tool-mode key. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-redmattertool-morningstar: Pickaxe, shovel and sledgehammer in one: digs stone, ore, metal, soil, sand and gravel at speed 14, 3x3 at a time (5x5 or one block with the tool-mode key; sneak for one block). 10 attack, tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-dark-shears: Cuts leaves at speed 12 and plants and cloth at 8. Tier 5; never wears out.
itemdesc-mattertool-red-shears: Cuts leaves at speed 18 and plants and cloth at 12. Tier 6; never wears out.
itemdesc-kleinstar-zwei:
Holds up to 200,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
itemdesc-kleinstar-drei:
Holds up to 800,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
itemdesc-kleinstar-vier:
Holds up to 3,200,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
itemdesc-kleinstar-sphere:
Holds up to 12,800,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
itemdesc-kleinstar-omega:
Holds up to 51,200,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-white: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-plain: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-gray: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-black: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-brown: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-red: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-orange: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-yellow: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-green: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-blue: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-purple: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-alchemicalbag-pink: A 32-slot bag. Wear it in a backpack slot.
itemdesc-matterarmor-dark-head: 98% protection, 2.4 flat damage reduction, protection tier 5. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-dark-body: 98% protection, 2.4 flat damage reduction, protection tier 5. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-dark-legs: 98% protection, 2.4 flat damage reduction, protection tier 5. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-red-head: 98.5% protection, 3 flat damage reduction, protection tier 6, +3% walk speed per piece. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-red-body: 98.5% protection, 3 flat damage reduction, protection tier 6, +3% walk speed per piece. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-red-legs: 98.5% protection, 3 flat damage reduction, protection tier 6, +3% walk speed per piece. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-gem-head: 99% protection, 3.6 flat damage reduction, protection tier 7, +6% walk speed and +15% healing per piece. A full set (helmet, chestplate, leggings) makes you immune to fall and fire damage. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-gem-body: 99% protection, 3.6 flat damage reduction, protection tier 7, +6% walk speed and +15% healing per piece. A full set (helmet, chestplate, leggings) makes you immune to fall and fire damage. Never wears out.
itemdesc-matterarmor-gem-legs: 99% protection, 3.6 flat damage reduction, protection tier 7, +6% walk speed and +15% healing per piece. A full set (helmet, chestplate, leggings) makes you immune to fall and fire damage. Never wears out.
blockdesc-alchemicalfuelblock-alchemical: 9 alchemical coal: burns at 1,400 °C for 1,440 seconds.
blockdesc-alchemicalfuelblock-mobiusfuel: 9 mobius fuel: burns at 1,500 °C for 5,760 seconds.
blockdesc-alchemicalfuelblock-aeternalis: 9 aeternalis fuel: burns at 1,600 °C for 23,040 seconds.
blockdesc-alchemicalchest: 104 slots of storage (a vanilla chest has 16).
blockdesc-matterfurnace-dark: Smelts, fires and cooks anything with smelting data - ore straight to ingots, no crucible needed. Runs on fuel or on EMC from adjacent collectors and relays.
blockdesc-matterfurnace-red: Like the dark matter furnace, but four times as fast and hot enough for anything.
blockdesc-antimatterrelay-mk1:
Stores up to 100,000 EMC from collectors, adds 1 EMC a second while it holds any, and passes up to 64 EMC a second on to condensers, furnaces and emptier relays.
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-antimatterrelay-mk2:
Stores up to 1,000,000 EMC from collectors, adds 3 EMC a second while it holds any, and passes up to 192 EMC a second on to condensers, furnaces and emptier relays.
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-antimatterrelay-mk3:
Stores up to 10,000,000 EMC from collectors, adds 10 EMC a second while it holds any, and passes up to 640 EMC a second on to condensers, furnaces and emptier relays.
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
blockdesc-novaexplosive-catalyst: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to light it: explodes 4 seconds later with a radius of 6 blocks, and everything it breaks drops.
blockdesc-novaexplosive-cataclysm: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to light it: explodes 6 seconds later with a radius of 11 blocks, and everything it breaks drops.
blockdesc-interdictiontorch: Pushes hostile creatures out of an 8-block radius, 4 times a second. Gives off light level 20 (a torch gives 14). Needs no fuel.
blockdesc-pedestal-empty: Right-click with a ring, stone, amulet, talisman or watch to set it here: it then works on the area around the pedestal for free (see each item's description for what it does on a pedestal, usually 6-12 blocks).
blockdesc-pedestal-active: Working on the area around it for free. Right-click with an empty hand to take the item back.
eye-notarget: No block chosen - sneak + right-click a block to choose one.
divining-result: {0} blocks deep: {1} EMC in total, {2} per block on average. Most valuable: {3} ({4} EMC).
furnace-burning: Burning: {0}s of heat left, {1} EMC stored
furnace-cold: Cold - add fuel or feed it EMC ({1} EMC stored)
relay-bonus: Bonus: {0} EMC/s, passes on up to {1} EMC/s
blockhelp-relay-withdraw: Take stored EMC (empty hand or Klein star)
arcana-none: All four effects are switched off (tool-mode key)
gale-outofemc: Swiftwolf's Rending Gale ran out of EMC and switched off.
gadget-charge-catalytic: Charge {0}: tunnel {1} deep; shots radius {2} ({3} EMC)
hotkey-fire: Vintage-E: fire projectile (lenses, amulets, Ignition Ring)
cmd-emc-added: Added {0} EMC to {1}. They now have {2} EMC.
cmd-emc-removed: Took {0} EMC from {1}. They now have {2} EMC.
cmd-emc-gotadded: {0} gave you {1} EMC. You now have {2} EMC.
cmd-emc-gotremoved: {0} took {1} EMC from you. You now have {2} EMC.
cmd-emc-needplayer: Name an online player when running this from the console.
cmd-emc-positive: The amount must be a number above 0.
cmdhelp-add: Add EMC to a player's personal EMC (yours if no name is given)
cmdhelp-remove: Take EMC from a player's personal EMC (yours if no name is given; never below 0)
cmdhelp-blacklist: Open a window listing everything on the EMC blacklist; select one to give it a value or take it off the blacklist
blacklist-summary: {0} blocks and items are blacklisted: they never get an EMC value ({1} have one). Select one to give it a value or take it off the blacklist so recipes can value it. Vintage-E {2}.
blacklist-summary-none: Nothing is blacklisted ({1} blocks and items have a value). Vintage-E {2}.
cmd-blacklisted: {0} ({1}) is now blacklisted and has no EMC value. Saved to ModConfig/vintagee.json.
cmd-unblacklisted: {0} ({1}) is off the blacklist but nothing gives it a value yet; it is on /emc missing now.
cmd-unblacklisted-value: {0} ({1}) is off the blacklist and now worth {2} EMC.
itemdesc-trinket-voidring:
Gem of Eternal Density and Black Hole Band in one: while on it pulls in items within 7 blocks and condenses junk worth 8 EMC or less into the target (tool-mode key).
Sneak + right-click: teleport to the block you look at, up to 64 blocks away. Free, twice a second at most.
Right-click a water or lava source to remove it.
Can be worn in your arm slot, where it keeps working.
blockdesc-furnace-dark-cold:
Works like the game's firepit (same window, fuel slot, cooking pots, crucibles and spits; light it with a firestarter or torch), but made of dark matter:
fuel burns 1.4x hotter and lasts 3x as long, and food, clay and metal cook or melt 4x faster once hot.
Collectors and relays next to it can power it instead: with nothing burning it lights itself on EMC, 2 EMC a second at 1,819 °C.
blockdesc-furnace-dark-lit:
Works like the game's firepit (same window, fuel slot, cooking pots, crucibles and spits; light it with a firestarter or torch), but made of dark matter:
fuel burns 1.4x hotter and lasts 3x as long, and food, clay and metal cook or melt 4x faster once hot.
Collectors and relays next to it can power it instead: with nothing burning it lights itself on EMC, 2 EMC a second at 1,819 °C.
blockdesc-furnace-dark-extinct:

blockdesc-furnace-red-cold:
Works like the game's firepit (same window, fuel slot, cooking pots, crucibles and spits; light it with a firestarter or torch), but made of red matter:
fuel burns 2x hotter and lasts 4x as long, and food, clay and metal cook or melt 12x faster once hot.
Collectors and relays next to it can power it instead: with nothing burning it lights itself on EMC, 4 EMC a second at 2,600 °C.
blockdesc-furnace-red-lit:
Works like the game's firepit (same window, fuel slot, cooking pots, crucibles and spits; light it with a firestarter or torch), but made of red matter:
fuel burns 2x hotter and lasts 4x as long, and food, clay and metal cook or melt 12x faster once hot.

missing-modhint-pick: Pick a mod in the mod filter to do the whole mod at once.
missing-nogame: The base game can't be blacklisted or unblacklisted as a whole; select its blocks and items instead.
missing-unblacklistingmod: Taking everything from {0} off the blacklist...
cmd-setmany: {0} blocks/items are now worth {1} EMC each. Saved to ModConfig/vintagee.json.
cmd-blacklistedmany: {0} blocks/items are now blacklisted. Saved to ModConfig/vintagee.json.
cmd-blacklistedmod: Everything from {0} is now blacklisted (saved as "{0}:*" in ModConfig/vintagee.json).
cmd-unblacklistedmod: Everything from {0} is off the blacklist.
cmdhelp-dumphand: Show the held item's value and how it was worked out, with its ingredients (also written to ModData/vintagee)
dump-stack: This stack of {0}: {1} EMC in total (its condition or contents count too)
dump-cached: These values came from the cache: run /emc recalc to see where they came from.
dump-noorigin: set directly (a value file, the server config or /emc set)
tooltip-data-full-contents: Transmutes with its contents (counted in its EMC)
tooltip-data-itemprice-contents: Transmutes with its contents, for the item's price only
tooltip-data-item: Transmutes as the plain item (what it holds or is made of isn't kept)
error-toomanyexact: You already know {0} exact versions (filled containers, chiseled blocks...), the most allowed. Ctrl + right-click entries you don't need to forget them.
contents-help: {0} blocks/items hold things or keep what they're made of on the item. Item only: burns and is created as the plain item (containers that hold something won't burn). Item + contents: worth the item plus its contents or material, and you learn and create exactly that version. Item price only: exactly that version, but it costs and burns for the item alone; its contents are free. (Vintage-E {1})
contents-empty: Nothing here holds contents or keeps a material.
contents-select: Click names to select them, then pick a mode below.
cmd-contents-kleinstar: Klein stars always keep their stored EMC; there's nothing to change.
cmdhelp-contents: Open the list of everything that holds things or keeps its material on the item, and switch how each is transmuted
cmdhelp-contentsset: Set the held item: item only, item + contents (full), item price only, or back to the default
cmdhelp-configure: Open the settings window, or show and change one setting from chat (true/false, numbers, list and table entries; /emc configure list prints them all); saved and applied straight away
cfg-howto: /emc configure <setting> shows what it does; /emc configure <setting> <value> changes it. Lists: add <entry> / remove <entry> / clear. Tables: set <key> <value> / remove <key> / clear. /emc configure reload re-reads the file after editing it by hand.
cfg-howto-list: Change it: /emc configure {0} add <entry> | remove <entry> | clear
cfg-howto-table: Change it: /emc configure {0} set <key> <value> | remove <key> | clear
cfg-unknown: There's no setting called {0}. /emc configure lists them all.
cfg-reloaded: Settings re-read from ModConfig/vintagee.json and applied.
cfg-badmode: {0} isn't a contents mode: use item, full or itemprice.
cfg-remapped: Saved; EMC values were worked out again.
cfg-restart: Saved; it takes effect the next time the server starts.
announce-configure: Vintage-E can be configured in game: /emc configure opens a window with every setting, what it does, and a way to change it. /emc help lists every command.
cfg-hint-bool: Switch it on or off, then Save.
cfg-hint-list: One entry per line (codes and wildcards like game:rock-*), then Save.
cfg-hint-table: One "key = value" per line (e.g. game:rock-granite = 2), then Save.
cfg-badline: This line needs to be "key = value": {0}
missing-unblacklisthint: Blacklisted entries (red): select them, then take them off the blacklist.
blacklist-blacklisthint: Missing entries (amber): select them, then blacklist them.
